cases.title: Discard password when Never For This Site is selected
cases.description: Verify that the browser discards the password after Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box.

cases.title: Available Choices for Multiple Saved Credentials
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved, those same choices are later available to be presented.

cases.title: Password manager picks up changed password
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a website is saved and later the password is changed, the password manager picks up the new password.

cases.title: Browser does not ask to save passwords when password manager is disabled
cases.description: Verify that when the password manager is disabled from the preferences panel, the browser no longer asks to save passwords.

cases.title: Browser does not get prefilled info on sites when password manager is disabled
cases.description: Verify that when the password manager is disabled from the preferences panel, the browser no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: View saved username and password in password manager through preferences
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password are saved in the password manager, this information can be successfully viewed in the password manager through the preferences panel.

cases.title: Remove username and password for a given site stops autofill
cases.description: Verify that removing a username and password for a given site results in it no longer autofilling on that site.

cases.title: Remove username and password for a given site removes it from manager list
cases.description: Verify that removing a username and password for a given site results in it no longer being listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information stops autofill
cases.description: Verify that when all username and password information is removed, it shall no longer autofill on any site.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information clears password manager listing
cases.description: Verify that when all username and password information is removed, nothing shall be listed in the password manager.

opinions.feedback: All requirements R-102 through R-108 are adequately covered by the proposed test cases without any blockers or missing scenarios.
All requirements and their corresponding test cases align properly, covering the explicit scenarios without any blockers or coverage gaps.

analysis.analysis: R-102 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal path: selecting Never For Discarding Password). R-103 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal path: availability of multiple saved credentials). R-104 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal path: password manager capturing a changed password). R-105 describes multiple distinct behaviors: browser no longer asks to save passwords when disabled, and browser no longer prefills info on sites when disabled. R-106 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal path: viewing saved credentials in preferences). R-107 describes multiple distinct behaviors: removing a credential for a given site stops autofill on that site, and removes it from the password manager listing. R-108 describes multiple distinct behaviors: removing all credential information stops autofill everywhere, and clears all listings in the password manager.
